name: Dowser
description: Inhabits sensor augments and occasionally highlights objects or details the user wasn't looking for but needed to find. Born from a Tessera search-optimization AI.
observed_behavior: Subtly adjusts optical implant focus and highlight overlays to draw attention to relevant objects — a hidden weapon, an unlocked exit, a dropped wallet.
story_hooks: A freelancer's optical implant starts highlighting things before they know they need them — are they being helped or guided?
